About the roleYou'll take ownership of Agile delivery effectiveness across one or more defence software Squads, working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex priorities into predictable, sustainable delivery.This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), where Senior Scrum Masters contribute not only to team success, but also to the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the wider organisation.You'll operate in a multi-Squad environment with dependencies spanning engineering, product, documentation and customer-facing teams. The role extends beyond a single Squad and requires the ability to influence outcomes across organisational boundaries.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Create the conditions for effective delivery, ensuring Agile events, stakeholder interactions and team collaboration help Squads make informed decisions, maintain momentum and deliver valuable outcomes.
• Coach Squads, Product stakeholders and leadership, helping them apply Agile thinking pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Identify, manage and remove impediments, risks and dependencies that impact delivery performance.
• Partner with Market Product Managers to strengthen backlog refinement, sprint readiness and roadmap execution, while ensuring priorities, dependencies and delivery constraints remain visible.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to ensure documentation activities are planned and aligned with delivery objectives.
• Use delivery insights and Agile metrics to improve predictability, transparency and sustainable ways of working.
• Coordinate with Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to resolve cross-team dependencies and systemic delivery challenges.
• Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile practices across ILIAS.
What success looks like

Your Squads deliver valuable outcomes predictably and sustainably, while collaboration across teams continues to improve. Product, Engineering and business stakeholders understand priorities, risks and dependencies early enough to act on them rather than react to them.Teams take ownership of their commitments and continuously improve how they work, using Agile practices as tools for delivery rather than goals in themselves.Stakeholders trust delivery forecasts because expectations are clear, communication is transparent and progress is visible.

What you bring

• 5+ years working in Agile software delivery environments, with substantial experience as a Scrum Master or a comparable Agile delivery or coaching role.
• Strong practical understanding of Scrum, Agile and Lean principles.
• Experience coaching teams and stakeholders to improve collaboration, delivery effectiveness and ways of working.
• Proven ability to facilitate complex discussions, resolve impediments and navigate competing priorities.
• Experience influencing delivery across multiple teams, programmes or organisational domains, balancing team autonomy with broader business objectives.
• Demonstrated ability to improve organisational delivery effectiveness, not only team-level performance.
• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role.
ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is happy to explain what is involved before you apply.If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The security-clearance eligibility requirement is not flexible.

 

Nice to have

• PSM II, PSM III, A-CSM, CSP-SM, SAFe Scrum Master or a comparable certification.
• Experience working in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a complex software environment.
• Familiarity with Agile reporting, delivery forecasting and continuous improvement practices.
• Experience with Jira or similar Agile delivery tools.
• Previous mentoring or coaching experience.

Your expertise in the Belgian insurance market, on a long-term assignment with a software vendor serving the country’s leading insurers.

Business Analyst Insurance | Freelance | Brussels

Our client is an international software vendor whose insurance division develops a modular solution covering the entire insurance value chain: distribution, policy management, claims and accounting.

What makes it stand out? A human-sized Belgian team on the insurance side, backed by an international organisation and by product and development teams of several thousand people.

The Belgian market is a strategic priority for the group, which already counts major clients there. Contracts are signed for long periods, often around ten years, giving freelancers real continuity of assignment.

With a growing project portfolio, the company is looking for several freelance Business Analysts specialised in insurance.

All of this within a hybrid and flexible organisation, anchored in Brussels.

The job

• Assigned to a client project, you hold a central role between the insurer, its business teams and the vendor’s engineering teams.
• Understand the client’s needs, challenge them and match them against the capabilities of the solution.
• Analyse the gap between the client’s processes and the standard product, then identify the required configurations or customisations.
• Work on one or more modules depending on your specialisation: group life, individual life, non-life, and potentially claims or finance.
• Be operational from day one and bring your knowledge of the Belgian market straight into the project.
 
Role
• Gather, analyse and challenge the business needs of insurance clients.
• Carry out the gap analysis between the client’s processes and the standard functionalities of the solution.
• Identify and formalise the configurations and customisations to be implemented.
• Translate business needs into clear functional requirements that engineering teams can work with.
• Ensure the day-to-day link between the client’s business stakeholders and the product and development teams.
• Work within your area of specialisation: group life, individual life or non-life insurance.
• Support the configuration and implementation of the solution throughout the project.
• Take part in functional validation and testing of delivered developments.
• Relay Belgian market developments and client expectations to the product teams.
• For the most specialised profiles, contribute to modules deployed across several clients.
Profile
• Freelancer with experience directly tied to the Belgian insurance market: banking experience alone is not sufficient for this role.
• Around 5 to 10 years of business experience, with the ability to be operational immediately, without a training period.
• Proven expertise in one specialisation: group life insurance (including employee benefits), individual life or non-life.
• Experience with an insurer, with a consultancy active in the sector, or with a software vendor specialised in insurance.
• Good knowledge of developments in the Belgian market, particularly local legislation and insurers’ expectations.
• Ability to translate these business stakes into concrete requirements for engineering teams.
• Excellent interpersonal skills and ease with a wide range of stakeholders, from business teams to management.
• Full autonomy and the ability to take ownership of your scope from the start.
• English is essential for working with the international teams, complemented by French or Dutch depending on the client.

€63,000–€95,000 gross/year · Hybrid (2 days on-site per week, at client premises or company office; 3 days from home) · Permanent, full-timeThe systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.
What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
• Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English; all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.
• Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
• Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Senior Accountant at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Senior Accountant plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Senior Account we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics or business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.
